domain_description: Automated error detection, root cause analysis, auto-healing, and error pattern learning for self-healing software systems. Covers error template matching, failure mode classification, remediation execution, and continuous learning from error resolution patterns aligned with ITIL and IEEE standards.
authority_sources: ITIL v4 (IT Infrastructure Library - Problem Management)
NIST SP 800-184 (Guide for Cybersecurity Event Recovery)

engines.name: Error Template Matching Engine
engines.function: Match runtime errors, exceptions, and failure signatures against a library of 45,962+ error templates using fuzzy matching, regex patterns, stack trace analysis, and contextual similarity scoring for rapid error identification.
doctrine_topics: error signature extraction and normalization
fuzzy string matching for error message comparison
stack trace parsing and frame analysis
error template schema design and indexing
contextual similarity scoring for ambiguous errors
multi-language error pattern support (Python, JS, Rust, Go)
error classification taxonomy per IEEE 1044
template confidence scoring and ranking
false positive reduction in template matching
template versioning and deprecation management

golden_queries.question: Given a Python stack trace showing 'ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer' during an API call to a Cloudflare Worker, match it against the template library and provide the top 3 matching templates with confidence scores
How does the template matching engine handle novel errors that have no existing template match, and what is the escalation path?

engines.name: Root Cause Analysis Engine
engines.function: Perform automated root cause analysis using fault tree analysis, causal chain decomposition, 5-why methodology, and dependency graph traversal to identify the underlying cause of system failures.
doctrine_topics: fault tree analysis (FTA) construction and evaluation
causal chain decomposition and event sequencing
5-why automated questioning methodology
dependency graph traversal for failure propagation
log correlation and timeline reconstruction
Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram generation
failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)
change correlation analysis (recent deployments, config changes)
resource exhaustion detection (memory, CPU, disk, connections)
intermittent failure analysis and reproduction strategies

golden_queries.question: A production FastAPI service starts returning 503 errors at 2:47 AM. Logs show memory usage climbing from 2GB to 7.8GB over 4 hours before the crash. Three new deployments occurred in the preceding 24 hours. Perform root cause analysis.

engines.name: Auto-Healing Engine
engines.function: Execute automated remediation actions for detected errors including service restarts, configuration rollbacks, resource scaling, circuit breaker activation, and dependency failover per predefined healing playbooks.
doctrine_topics: healing playbook design and execution framework
service restart and graceful degradation protocols
configuration rollback and version management
circuit breaker pattern implementation
automatic resource scaling and rebalancing
dependency failover and fallback chain execution
healing action safety checks and blast radius limiting
rollback verification and success criteria
healing action audit trail and compliance logging
human-in-the-loop escalation for high-risk actions

golden_queries.question: Design an auto-healing playbook for a microservice that experiences cascading failures when its database connection pool is exhausted, including safety checks, blast radius limits, and rollback criteria

engines.name: Error Pattern Learning Engine
engines.function: Learn from resolved errors to improve future detection and remediation by extracting resolution patterns, updating template libraries, training classification models, and predicting emerging failure modes.
doctrine_topics: error resolution pattern extraction and codification
template library auto-generation from resolved incidents
error classification model training and updating
failure mode prediction and early warning
resolution effectiveness scoring and feedback loops
error frequency trend analysis and alerting
cross-system error correlation and pattern transfer
seasonal and temporal error pattern detection
error budget tracking and SLO alignment
continuous improvement metrics (MTTR, MTTD, MTBF)

golden_queries.question: Given 6 months of incident data showing 1,200 resolved incidents across 45 microservices, describe how the learning engine would identify recurring patterns, generate new templates, and predict which services are most likely to fail next week
